---
title: "Long Vegetation Table"
format:
  html:
    theme: journal
params:
  plot_number: "00000"
  db_path: "../data/vpro.duckdb"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(duckdb)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

options(knitr.table.format = "html")
con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), params$db_path, read_only = TRUE)
```

```{r load-data, include=FALSE}
veg <- dbGetQuery(
  con,
  "SELECT * FROM vw_USysAllVeg WHERE PlotNumber = ?",
  list(params$plot_number)
)

dbDisconnect(con)

if (nrow(veg) > 0) {
  desired <- c("PlotNumber", "MyLayer", "Species", "CoverValue", "HeightValue", "Constancy")
  cols <- intersect(desired, names(veg))
  veg <- veg[, cols, drop = FALSE]
}
```

# Plot: `r params$plot_number`

```{r veg-table, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (nrow(veg) > 0) {
  kbl(veg, align = "l") %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
} else {
  cat("No vegetation data found.")
}
```
